_comment: Lebanon fintech/money-transfer/bank-compliance pitch. User's exact fixed copy, no signal variation. Salutation slot only change from the source text (Hi [Name], -> Hi {salutation},). No em-dashes. Renders through email_template.py at send.
subject_template: A faster way through your AML alerts
body_template:
Hi {salutation},

Hope your week's going smoothly. I've been looking closely at how money transfer operations run in Lebanon, and I've noticed the same thing almost everywhere: the analysts who should be watching real risks spend their day closing alerts that turn out to be nothing, and re-checking ID documents that were photographed badly at the counter the first time. With the FATF grey list, that load is only going up.

I'm David Geha, a third year Engineering student at AUB, and I work with OSG (https://osgdev.com). We're AI consultants: we find where a business is losing time and money and build AI systems around those exact gaps. We've done this for marketing agencies, F&B businesses and oil and gas companies across Lebanon and the GCC.

Would you be open to a 20 minute call so we can go through the details together? If a quick call is easier, my direct number is +961 76 412 978.

Best regards,
David Geha
OSG
https://osgdev.com
Instagram: dave.automates
